synopsis: After traveling into a historical BL novel, the actor Lin Yan gains a special ability: fast-traveling through a skill called [Escape Death]. His first mission? To secretly orchestrate an attack on Prince Qi Zhen, which leads to the prince becoming the villain. Lin Yan’s first identity in this world is none other than Lin Shou Yan, the prince’s foolish fiancé. But as he plays his role, he accidentally captures the prince’s heart, and his fake death turns out to be the key reason Qi Zhen becomes a ruthless tyrant! A cold, overthinking tsundere prince and his scheming, perverted fiancé—chaos ensues! (Source: KuiaKan Manhua, translated)

title: Nightmare Funk
titleNative: ナイトメア・ファンク
synopsis: Kurusu Hiyori is a young policewoman and the daughter of a former police chief. She has the unusual curse of having predictive dreams of a person's murder the following day. Tragically, the first of these dreams she experienced showed her the death of her own father. Over time, the dreams have led to her social isolation, a kind of grim-reaper reputation, and a lot of problems at work—the police are not fond of her habit of rushing off to investigate future crimes she saw in her dreams. Even worse, the dreams that have left her as an adult bedwetter have not enabled her to save a single person. That all changes, on the day after she dreams of the assassination of Claus Haida, a creepy foreigner. She is overjoyed to have rescued him, but it turns out that he is something of a monster himself. He works for a foreign company, and has decided that it is in both of their interests for the two of them to team up. He is undeniably useful, but can Hiyori really join forces with such a person? (Source: MangaHelpers) Included one-shot: Akumu Imouto! Umaru-chan (悪夢妹！うまるちゃん)

synopsis: The Hermes family has produced many talented magicians. However, it turns out that only the third son, Frey, has an aptitude for the ice attribute, which is unpopular in modern times. As a result, Frey is scorned by those around him and banished from the Hermes family. "I'll show them... I'll become stronger," Frey resolves, and meets a lovely girl. However, she turns out to be none other than Arcelia, the Sage of Ice, one of the Seven Sages who saved the world. In order to become the world's strongest ice-attribute magician, Frey looks up to Arcelia as his master, but before long, his feelings turn to love. Will he even propose marriage?! (Source: Young Champion Web, translated)

title: Itezuru
synopsis: O-Tsuru (the crane), named because she used to stand on one foot to warm the other, was sold by her parents to become a geisha. She will begin as a shikomikka (apprentice) in an okiya: the house where the geisha live. By doing the commissions of his elders, Tsuru will discover the life of these women. Finally, one day, her turn arrives. She goes to her benefactor's room. Who, by paying the ceremony fees, will bring it into the world of geisha. Tsuru will then take the name of Tsurugiku and become a famous geisha in the world of pleasures. Note: It was first collected in a volume in 1992.
